title: Yantian International Container Terminal COVID-19 disruption, May-June 2021
why_this_event: It is a CONTAINER PORT CAPACITY disruption, which is exactly what world_models/supply_chain/port_disruption.json models. A canal blockage (e.g. Suez 2021) would have required modelling a different mechanism.

The reported capacity loss (to ~30% of normal, i.e. -70 index points) coincidentally matches the magnitude of the simulator's default scenario, so the replay tests the model in the regime it was designed for.
The duration (~4.5 weeks) is long enough to be resolved by weekly simulation, unlike the six-day Suez blockage.
The timeline is documented in publicly readable trade sources with dates.
No classified or proprietary data is required to define the event.
Chosen on data availability, not on prominence: Suez 2021 is the more famous event but is too short for weekly resolution and disrupts a canal rather than a port.

shipping_delay.note: March 2021 is used, NOT April 2021, even though April describes a period closer to the event. The April figure was published on 2021-05-31, six days AFTER the event start, so it was not available at the knowledge cutoff. Using it would be hindsight leakage.

port_capacity.note: Baseline by construction: the index is defined so that normal pre-event operation is 100. Not an observation.

event.label: Yantian throughput to ~30% of normal
event.description: COVID-19 outbreak among terminal workers; portions of Yantian International Container Terminal shuttered from the last week of May 2021, with operating capacity reported at about 30% of normal.

evidence.note: Reported operating capacity of 30% of normal during the peak of the disruption.
Portions of the port shuttered since the last week of May 2021.

additional_events.label: Yantian partial reopening to ~70% of normal
additional_events.description: A closed section partially reopened on 10 June 2021 after nearly two weeks; operating capacity reported at about 70% of normal before full resumption on 24 June 2021.

evidence.note: Partial reopening of a closed section as of 10 June 2021.
Operations reported at around 70% capacity after partial recovery.

event_status_note: The injected event is recorded as expert_assumption, NOT observed. The capacity percentages come from operational statements in trade press rather than measured throughput, and the step boundaries carry a few days of date uncertainty. Marking it 'observed' would overstate what is known about the input.
description: Weekly replay of the Yantian 2021 terminal disruption. Week 1 begins on 2021-05-25. The injected event holds port_capacity at 30 index points for two weeks, then at 70 index points for two weeks, then releases; the model's own dynamics govern everything downstream and the recovery.
